comment: Fiber 3.5 on Go 1.27 and fasthttp, one function per family registering its routes in the implementation package under Implementation/, and the server's main package in container-h1. The suite is UnitTests/, go test over the app served on a loopback port, and never reaches the image. c.Bind() runs go-playground's validator, registered as the app's StructValidator as Fiber's validation guide registers it, and a validation failure is answered as the guide's step 4 answers one. Any other bind failure is returned to Fiber's default error handler, as the guide returns it, which answers a BindError with 500. The first-error route is wired by hand, because go-playground cannot stop at the first failure. The lockfile is go.mod, which records every module version the build selects, and go.sum, which holds their hashes. upgrade is go get -u ./..., which moves every module to its newest release within its major version.

noHandler.cors.preflight: Fiber's cors middleware on the /cors group answers the preflight with 204. Fiber lets a preflight reach the group's middleware although no route has OPTIONS.
noHandler.errors.unmatched: Fiber's router answers a path no route matches with ErrNotFound, which its default error handler writes as 404 and the status text.
noHandler.errors.wrong_method: Fiber's router answers a method the path has no route for with ErrMethodNotAllowed, which its default error handler writes as 405, with an Allow header naming the methods the path has.

authorized.mechanism: A middleware on the route that compares the bearer token and returns fiber.ErrForbidden for any other, because Fiber's keyauth middleware answers a wrong key with 401

baseline.builtin: c.SendString writes the text, as text/plain by fasthttp's default.

body.mechanism: c.Bind().Body decodes the order by its Content-Type and runs the app's StructValidator, the go-playground adapter from Fiber's validation guide, over the validate tags. The first-error route binds with SkipValidation and runs the validator over one field at a time, because go-playground cannot stop at the first failure

cache.mechanism: Fiber's cache middleware in front of each cache route, one store for the process, keeping the response's headers and partitioning each entry on the request headers its Vary names

compressed.mechanism: Fiber's compress middleware on the two /compressed routes, at its fastest level

cors.mechanism: Fiber's cors middleware on the /cors group, which a preflight reaches with no OPTIONS route

errors.builtin: Fiber's default error handler answers a miss with 404 and a method a path lacks with 405, each as text/plain with the status text. A body the binder cannot decode reaches it as a BindError and is answered 500, and the items handlers return fiber.ErrNotFound for a missing row.

etag.mechanism: Fiber's etag middleware on the two /etag routes, which tags the body with its length and CRC-32 and answers a matching If-None-Match with 304

forms.builtin: c.Bind().Form reads a urlencoded or a multipart body into the form tags, the file part as a *multipart.FileHeader.

headers.builtin: c.Bind().Header fills the header tags, the account as an int.

items.builtin: One route per method on /items/:id, the id bound with c.Bind().URI. Fiber registers a HEAD route beside each GET route, so the read route answers HEAD too.

json.builtin: c.JSON encodes the payload with the app's JSONEncoder, which is encoding/json's Marshal unless the config names another.

middleware.mechanism: No-op handlers ahead of the handler in the route's chain, four or sixteen of them, each calling c.Next

parameters.builtin: c.Bind().URI fills the uri tags, each capture as an int.

query.builtin: c.Bind().Query fills the query tags, the numbers as ints.

sse.builtin: sse.New, Fiber's own event stream handler, sets the headers, streams the body and flushes each event. The route's handler sends each row as one event.

static.builtin: static.New serves the payload directory on a wildcard route through fasthttp's file server.

stream.builtin: c.SendStreamWriter hands fasthttp a function that writes the body after the handler returns. It writes each row and its newline and flushes it.

template.mechanism: gofiber/template's html engine over html/template, from the embedded views, set as the app's Views, which c.Render reaches
